title: Claude Fable 5 & the Mythos Tier
content:
## Overview

On June 9, 2026, Anthropic launched **Claude Fable 5** (`claude-fable-5`), its most capable widely released model, alongside **Claude Mythos 5** (`claude-mythos-5`), a restricted-access tier for defensive research. Fable 5 introduces a model class above Opus and debuts several platform-breaking changes: a 1-million-token context window on by default, 128K max output tokens, always-on adaptive thinking, a new tokenizer, and per-request safety classifiers.

---

## What's New in Fable 5

### 1M Token Context Window (Default)

Fable 5 supports a **1-million-token context window by default** — no beta header, at standard pricing. The same context length was previously available only in beta on Sonnet and Opus 4.x models. Because the tokenizer changed, use the token counting API with `model: "claude-fable-5"` to measure prompts before migrating.

### 128K Max Output Tokens

Fable 5 raises maximum output to **128,000 tokens**, enabling long-form generation (entire code modules, structured datasets, long documents) in a single API call without batching.

### Adaptive Thinking Only

Fable 5 is the first model where **adaptive thinking is the only available thinking mode**. Manual thinking controls are removed:

- `thinking: {"type": "disabled"}` → 400 error
- Manual `budget_tokens` → 400 error
- Assistant prefill → 400 error

Thinking display defaults to `"omitted"` (same as Opus 4.7/4.8). Set `display: "summarized"` to receive human-readable thinking summaries. The raw chain of thought is never returned; pass thinking blocks back unchanged in multi-turn conversations.

### New Tokenizer

Fable 5 and Mythos 5 use the tokenizer introduced with Claude Opus 4.7. **The same text produces roughly 30% more tokens** compared to models before Opus 4.7. Any token budget calculations based on older models must be re-measured against Fable 5.

---

## Safety Classifiers & Refusal Handling

Fable 5 runs safety classifiers at request time and during response generation. When a classifier triggers, the API returns `stop_reason: "refusal"`. Related changes:

- **No billing on pre-output refusals**: Requests refused before any output tokens are generated are not billed.
- **`stop_details.category`** adds a third value `"reasoning_extraction"` — returned when a request attempts to reverse-engineer or duplicate model outputs. The existing `"cyber"` and `"bio"` categories are unchanged.
- **`fallbacks` parameter (beta)**: An opt-in parameter that automatically re-runs refused requests on a fallback model, billed at the fallback model's rates. Not supported on the Message Batches API.

---

## Data Retention Requirement

Fable 5 requires **30-day data retention** on the Claude API and is not available under zero data retention contracts.

---

## Claude Mythos 5 (Gated Research Access)

Claude Mythos 5 (`claude-mythos-5`) shares the same API surface and capabilities as Fable 5, but is available only to **Project Glasswing** participants — a gated program for defensive cybersecurity research. Access is invitation-only via [anthropic.com/glasswing](https://anthropic.com/glasswing).

---

## Export Control Disruption (June 12, 2026)

Three days after launch, Anthropic received a US government export-control directive requiring suspension of access to both Fable 5 and Mythos 5 for foreign nationals. Rather than build per-user access controls overnight, Anthropic suspended both models for all users. As of late June 2026, access has been partially restored for US customers and select government-approved entities under the Trump administration's export waiver program. Developers building on Fable 5 should monitor Anthropic's status page for current availability.

---

## Additional Platform Changes (June 9, 2026)

Launched alongside Fable 5:

- **Claude Managed Agents scheduled deployments**: Run agent sessions on a cron schedule (see [Claude Managed Agents](claude-managed-agents)).
- **Managed Agents vaults**: Secure environment variable credential injection for agent sandboxes.
- **Swift package (beta)**: Adds Claude as a server-side `LanguageModel` in Apple's Foundation Models framework, callable through the same `LanguageModelSession` API as Apple's on-device model on iOS 27, macOS 27, visionOS 27, and watchOS 27.

---

## Model Comparison (June 2026)

| Model | ID | Context | Max Output | Thinking |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Fable 5 | `claude-fable-5` | 1M (default) | 128K | Adaptive only |
| Mythos 5 | `claude-mythos-5` | 1M (default) | 128K | Adaptive only |
| Opus 4.8 | `claude-opus-4-8` | 1M (default) | 128K | Adaptive (optional) |
| Opus 4.7 | `claude-opus-4-7` | 200K | 128K | Adaptive (optional) |
| Sonnet 4.6 | `claude-sonnet-4-6` | 1M (default) | — | Supported |
| Haiku 4.5 | `claude-haiku-4-5-20251001` | 200K | — | — |

---

## Migration Checklist

- **Re-measure token budgets**: Fable 5's tokenizer produces ~30% more tokens for the same text vs. pre-Opus-4.7 models.
- **Remove thinking controls**: Any code that disables thinking or sets manual `budget_tokens` will return a 400 error on Fable 5.
- **Check data retention**: Confirm your API contract allows 30-day retention before routing traffic to Fable 5.
- **Prefill removal**: Code that sets assistant message prefills must be updated.
